objectives.en: Describe the data, address and control buses
Distinguish a microprocessor from a microcontroller

narration.en: Data moves between the CPU and memory billions of times a second. Like vehicles on a road, it needs a path. What are these paths called?
narration.kn: CPU ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಮರಣೆಯ ನಡುವೆ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಪ್ರತಿ ಸೆಕೆಂಡಿಗೆ ಕೋಟಿಗಟ್ಟಲೆ ಬಾರಿ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ರಸ್ತೆಯ ವಾಹನಗಳಂತೆ ಅದಕ್ಕೂ ದಾರಿ ಬೇಕು. ಈ ದಾರಿಗಳ ಹೆಸರೇನು?

body.en: Data travels between the CPU, memory and I/O devices on a set of wires called the system bus. The data bus carries the actual data and is bidirectional. The address bus carries the address of the memory location the CPU wants and is unidirectional, from the CPU to memory. The control bus carries control signals such as read and write.

points.en: Control bus: read/write and other control signals
An address bus of n lines can address 2ⁿ memory locations

The address bus carries the address of the memory location the CPU wants and is unidirectional, from the CPU to memory. The control bus carries control signals such as read and write.
narration.kn: CPU, ಸ್ಮರಣೆ ಮತ್ತು I/O ಸಾಧನಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಿಸ್ಟಮ್ ಬಸ್ ಮೂಲಕ ಸಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಡೇಟಾ ಬಸ್ ದ್ವಿಮುಖ, ಅಡ್ರೆಸ್ ಬಸ್ CPU ಯಿಂದ ಸ್ಮರಣೆಗೆ ಏಕಮುಖ, ಕಂಟ್ರೋಲ್ ಬಸ್ ಓದು/ಬರೆ ಸಂಕೇತಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: The system bus and microprocessor specifications

say.en: The CPU, memory and input-output devices are joined by a set of wires called the system bus.
The data bus carries the data itself. It is two-way: the CPU both reads and writes data.
The address bus carries the address of the memory location the CPU wants. It is one-way, from the CPU.
The control bus carries signals such as memory read and memory write.
With n address lines, the CPU can name 2 to the power n locations. Thirty-two lines give 4 GB.
A microprocessor is a whole CPU on one chip. We compare chips by these specifications.
The first microprocessor, the Intel 4004 of 1971, was 4-bit. Today’s processors are 64-bit and multi-core.

narration.en: We connect the CPU, memory and input-output devices with the data, address and control buses, then read a microprocessor’s specifications.

body.en: A microprocessor is a CPU built on a single chip. The first, the 4-bit Intel 4004, came in 1971; later came 8-bit, 16-bit, 32-bit and today's 64-bit processors. Its main specifications are word size (bits processed at a time), memory size it can address, clock speed (cycles per second, in GHz) and the number of cores. A microcontroller puts a processor, memory and input/output ports on one chip and is used inside appliances such as washing machines and microwave ovens.

points.en: Clock speed in hertz; 3 GHz = 3 × 10⁹ cycles per second
Multicore: several processing units (cores) on one chip
Microcontroller = processor + memory + I/O on one chip

narration.kn: ಒಂದೇ ಚಿಪ್ ಮೇಲೆ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿದ CPU ಯೇ ಮೈಕ್ರೋಪ್ರೊಸೆಸರ್. ಪದದ ಗಾತ್ರ, ಸ್ಮರಣೆ ಗಾತ್ರ, ಗಡಿಯಾರ ವೇಗ ಮತ್ತು ಕೋರ್‌ಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಅದರ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳು. ಮೈಕ್ರೋಕಂಟ್ರೋಲರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೊಸೆಸರ್, ಸ್ಮರಣೆ ಮತ್ತು I/O ಪೋರ್ಟ್‌ಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ಚಿಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತವೆ; ಇದು ತೊಳೆಯುವ ಯಂತ್ರ, ಮೈಕ್ರೋವೇವ್‌ನಂತಹ ಸಾಧನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
